panels.title: Répartition des étiquettes DPE reçues (flux temps réel)

targets.rawSql: SELECT etiquette_dpe AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM diagnostic_dpe_flux GROUP BY etiquette_dpe ORDER BY etiquette_dpe

panels.title: Origine des DPE reçus (backfill vs live)

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_flux AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM diagnostic_dpe_flux GROUP BY source_flux

panels.title: Volume de DPE traités dans le temps

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', traite_le) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM diagnostic_dpe_flux GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 10 communes les plus chères (prix moyen €/m², flux temps réel)

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.nom_commune AS metric, MAX(f.prix_m2_commune_reference) AS value FROM diagnostic_dpe_flux f JOIN commune c ON c.code_insee = f.code_insee WHERE f.prix_m2_commune_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.nom_commune ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Part de logements F-G par tranche de prix communal

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN prix_m2_commune_reference < 2000 THEN '< 2000€/m²' WHEN prix_m2_commune_reference < 3000 THEN '2000-3000€/m²' WHEN prix_m2_commune_reference < 4000 THEN '3000-4000€/m²' ELSE '>= 4000€/m²' END AS metric, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN etiquette_dpe IN ('F','G') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS value FROM diagnostic_dpe_flux WHERE prix_m2_commune_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.numero_dpe, c.nom_commune, f.etiquette_dpe, f.etiquette_ges, f.surface_habitable_logement, f.prix_m2_commune_reference, f.source_flux, f.traite_le FROM diagnostic_dpe_flux f JOIN commune c ON c.code_insee = f.code_insee ORDER BY f.traite_le DESC LIMIT 50
